compiled_state.title: [GREEN] Dispatch bug-classifier-haiku for qualifying closed bugs and write bug-type-<slug> tags
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies DD1: backfill-bug-types.sh has been run during the 4911 sprint and at least one valid bug-type-<slug> tag (not uncategorized) has been written through the dispatched bug-classifier-haiku agent.

## Implementation Steps
1. Get qualifying closed bugs (last 60 days, no bug-type-* tag, non-jira):
   .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --type=bug --status=closed
   Filter with Python: created_at/1e9 >= now-60*86400, no bug-type-* tag, not jira-*

2. For at least ONE qualifying ticket, read full details:
   .claude/scripts/dso ticket show <id>

3. Load the registry slug list from plugins/dso/docs/bug-classification-registry.json

4. Dispatch bug-classifier-haiku agent (model: haiku) with:
   - Registry slug list (27 slugs)
   - Ticket title + description
   - Instruction: return exactly one slug or "uncategorized"; partial match is not a match

5. Validate output (byte-exact match against slug set ∪ {uncategorized})

6. If valid slug (not uncategorized): write tag via:
   .claude/scripts/dso ticket tag <id> bug-type-<slug>

7. Capture: ticket ID processed, slug returned, tag written

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -3
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] At least one valid bug-type-<slug> tag (not uncategorized) exists on a closed bug ticket
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --type=bug --status=closed 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; ts=json.load(sys.stdin); count=sum(1 for t in ts for tag in (t.get('tags') or []) if tag.startswith('bug-type-') and 'uncategorized' not in tag and 'classifier-failed' not in tag); print(count); exit(0 if count>=1 else 1)"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
